Cysteine modified with propionamide was set as a fixed modification in the search.
Finally, the samples were dried via SpeedVac... and exchanged into LC-MS reconstitution buffer... for instrumental analysis.
Cysteine modified with propionamide was set as a fixed modification in the search. Variable modifications included oxidation on methionine and acetylation on protein N-terminus.
The eluant of the beads was run on an SDS-PAGE gel, and the bands corresponding to Sec18 were excised. ... desalted using MonoSpin C18 Solid-Phase Extraction (SPE) columns.
incubated the spheroplasts with disuccinimidyl glutarate (DSG) ... for 30 minutes
anti-HA co-immunoprecipitation (coIP) to isolate Sec18 and any bound proteins to it
we then incubated the spheroplasts with disuccinimidyl glutarate (DSG), a membrane permeable protein crosslinking agent, for 30 minutes
The excess DSG was then quenched with 1M Tris and incubated for another 15 minutes.
bands corresponding to crosslinked Sec18 were excised and sent for liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) analysis.
